text_blocks.snippet: Medications that can cause high platelets:

list.snippet: Corticosteroids: These medications, often used for inflammation and pain, can lead to increased platelet production.
Epinephrine: Also known as adrenaline, this can elevate platelet counts.
Antibiotics: Some antibiotics, like aztreonam (Azactam) and ceftazidime (Fortum), have been associated with thrombocytosis.
